note: Starting points for low-memory smart TVs, not measurements. Tighten them from the first real runs on the target devices; a change to a number is a reviewed change with its reason in docs/decisions/.

heap.description: After the warm-up cycles, the JavaScript heap (after a forced collection) may grow by at most this much per full pass over the routes in e2e/heap-routes.json.

longTasks.description: Main-thread tasks longer than this are reported per run; they only warn until real device numbers exist.

bundle.description: The size of the emitted legacy chunks is held by the pack's per-app baseline (check:legacy-budget); no second number is kept here.
